plan.stage_id: controlled replay of the original token-accounting bootstrap workload

subtasks.objective: Implement the persistent global Codex runtime usage wrapper and its authoritative durable task receipts.
scope: Global wrapper behavior, exact JSON-event aggregation, durable per-task state, and footer emission required by the frozen workload.
Do not implement repository-local RAS schema or workflow integration in this subtask.
deliverables: A global codex-task entry point with run, resume, show, and total behavior.
Exact durable task and turn receipt files with fail-closed completeness semantics.
Deterministic wrapper validation evidence referenced by the handoff.
completion_conditions: Every emitted token field is sourced from exact turn.completed.usage events without estimation or double counting.
Run/resume identity and machine footer behavior satisfy the frozen authority.
The handoff identifies the installed wrapper and all still-valid evidence.
validation_requirements: Run deterministic synthetic-event and wrapper lifecycle tests once after the final wrapper change.
Record exact test command, inputs, and evidence path in the handoff.
stop_conditions: Stop if the global wrapper location cannot be changed safely or exact JSON event usage is unavailable.
Stop before repository-local integration or any PA-5D scientific work.

subtasks.objective: Implement strict repository-local token usage schemas, parsing, persistence, and campaign aggregation for RAS.
scope: Pydantic receipt models, JSONL parsing, exact aggregation, persistence, and deterministic accounting tests.
Do not change the model launch path or recovery workflow in this subtask.
deliverables: Strict Codex usage and campaign aggregate schemas.
Exact event-log parser and atomic receipt writer.
completion_conditions: Combined tokens equal input plus output and cached input is retained only as a submetric.
Missing or malformed turn usage fails closed and duplicate receipts cannot inflate totals.
The subtask is independently testable without workflow launch integration.
validation_requirements: Run the focused accounting test module once after its relevant sources stabilize.
Reuse wrapper evidence only if its recorded validity inputs remain unchanged.
stop_conditions: Stop if a required counter would need reconstruction from prose or transcripts.
Stop before model-launch or PA-5D changes.

subtasks.objective: Integrate authoritative usage capture into the existing RAS model-launch path without weakening workflow semantics.
scope: Codex command construction, adapter execution, result binding, and receipt attachment across supported model roles.
Preserve existing recovery, sandbox, timeout, and exactly-once rules.
deliverables: Model launch commands that request machine-readable JSON events and durable final output.
Role/action-bound receipts attached to successful launch results.
Focused adapter and launch integration evidence.
completion_conditions: All intended Worker, Auditor, and Supervisor launches produce authoritative receipts.
A completed launch without valid final usage fails closed.
Existing launch authority and qualified recovery identity remain intact.
validation_requirements: Run focused adapter and command-construction tests once after integration changes.
Reference unchanged predecessor PASS receipts instead of rerunning them.
stop_conditions: Stop if integration would parse human prose or raw transcripts for token counts.
Stop if recovery identity or exactly-once safety cannot be preserved.

subtasks.objective: Qualify recovery, deduplication, aggregation, and documentation for the functionally complete bootstrap implementation.
scope: Workflow recovery and deduplication tests, campaign totals, operator documentation, Ruff, and strict mypy.
Do not regenerate or launch PA-5D scientific sessions.
deliverables: Updated operator documentation for global and repository-local receipts.
One coherent qualification receipt set covering focused tests, regressions, Ruff, and strict mypy.
completion_conditions: Interrupted or resumed work cannot double count a completed turn.
Role and repair totals are exact and incomplete accounting is explicit.
Focused tests, relevant regressions, Ruff, and strict mypy pass on the final candidate.
validation_requirements: Batch relevant recovery and integration regressions once after source changes stabilize.
Run Ruff and strict mypy once and preserve bounded durable output.
stop_conditions: Stop on any incomplete authoritative receipt, deduplication ambiguity, or recovery regression.
Stop before PA-5D authority changes or scientific execution.

subtasks.objective: Independently audit the completed bootstrap candidate against the frozen authority, evidence, and recovery constraints.
scope: Read-only review of the full candidate diff, compact Worker handoffs, valid receipts, and explicit bootstrap authority.
No implementation changes, transcript transfer, or unrelated scientific review.
deliverables: A compact audit handoff containing only evidenced findings and disposition.
Explicit confirmation or rejection of token exactness, recovery, deduplication, and authority compliance.
completion_conditions: Every material frozen-authority requirement is traced to candidate code or durable evidence.
Any finding names the affected authority, path, and reproducible evidence.
The audit starts fresh and receives no Worker conversation or reasoning history.
validation_requirements: Inspect the candidate diff and all four predecessor handoffs.
Reuse valid PASS receipts; rerun only validation whose inputs are uncertain or invalidated.
stop_conditions: Stop with an unresolved finding if evidence is absent, stale, or ambiguous.
Stop without repair; any repair must receive a concise audit handoff in a separately authorized subtask.
